en: Childlike colorful drawing of a riverside city with a large arched bridge in the foreground, cars and a cyclist crossing it, and a wide river with boats and waves. Houses appear on the left bank, people are shown enjoying the water and sun on the right, and a large boat painted in red, white, and blue sails on the river. The Dutch flag colors appear several times. The sky is bright blue with clouds, birds, and a red sun. Handwritten words label the scene and identify the bridge and river.
